sources.label: NAUR LesBin - Darklit Dragonsong - Role Quadrant, Healer Plant NW

steps.title: Stack in the middle
steps.cue: The Usurper turns into her dragon form
steps.rule: Gather in the middle so every Akh Rhai puddle lands on the same spot.

steps.title: Dodge Akh Rhai into your role quadrant
steps.cue: Akh Rhai puddles appear under the party
steps.rule: Leave the middle as the puddles drop and wait about 8 m out in your role's quadrant: healers north-west, tanks north-east, melee south-east, ranged south-west.

steps.title: Line up for Darklit Dragonsong
steps.rule: Form the two lineup arcs: supports just north of the middle (H1, H2, MT, OT from west to east), DPS about 10 m south (R1, R2, M1, M2 from west to east).

steps.title: Chains make the bowtie
steps.rule: Chained: healer north-west, tank north-east, the west DPS south-west and the east DPS south-east, about 8 m out; if the chains make a box the tank swaps with the east DPS, if an hourglass with the west DPS. Free: healer west and tank east just north of the middle, DPS south-west and south-east (ranged west, melee east; R2 or M1 takes west when the roles match).

steps.title: One Dark Water north, one south
steps.cue: The Path of Light cast starts
steps.rule: If both Dark Waters sit on the same half, the free player with water swaps straight across with the free player on the other half. Chained players then hold their corner to soak a tower; free players stay close to the boss for the cones.

steps.title: Spread for Spirit Taker
steps.rule: Chained players move out to their intercardinal; free supports go out on their side (the west one to the wall, the east one halfway); free DPS stay in, the east one under the boss. Keep clear of the crystal north.

steps.title: Stack for Dark Water away from the wing
steps.cue: Hallowed Wings cast starts: one wing glows
steps.rule: The glowing wing's half of the arena gets hit: go to the other half and stack on its intercardinal waymarks, north half with the north water and south half with the south water. Don't let the north stack touch the crystal.

steps.title: Bait Somber Dance far
steps.rule: You bait Somber Dance: run to the wall east or west, whichever is farther from Gaia, to take the first, farthest slam.

steps.title: Group up north and south
steps.rule: Everyone else regroups in two stacks about 6 m north and south of the middle, keeping their half, well away from the baiting tank.

steps.title: Take the close hit too
steps.rule: Right after the far slam, run back to Gaia and stand just past her on the outside to take the close slam as well (plan an invuln).

steps.title: Akh Morn: MT solo, party stacks
steps.rule: 7-1 Akh Morn: everyone stacks in the middle while the MT takes his share alone about 9 m west.

MainTank.rule: Take Akh Morn alone about 9 m west of the middle, away from the party stack.

steps.title: Stack for Morn Afah
steps.rule: Everyone, MT included, stacks in the middle for Morn Afah.
